iEEGCoordinateSystemDescription: SPM12 default template space (IXI549Space), reached through the dataset's own SPM deformation field.
iEEGCoordinateProcessingDescription: Computed by NEMAR (ieeg_geometry 0.1.0). Source: sub-4/ses-ieeg01/ieeg/sub-4_ses-ieeg01_electrodes.tsv, mapped to the SPM template space by inverting the dataset's SPM deformation field derivatives/freesurfer/sub-4/y_sub-4_ses-mri01_T1w.nii (inversion residual median 0.005 mm, maximum 0.030 mm). The file was paired with the field by: template verification (inside 98.8% against 42.4% for sub-4_ses-ieeg01_space-ACPC_electrodes.tsv). Field check on the subject's own pial surface (4000 sampled vertices inverted): median 5.33 mm and 10th percentile 1.49 mm from the MNI152NLin2009cAsym shell, centroid 5.4 mm from the shell's, largest axis-extent difference 7%. Plausibility against the MNI152NLin2009cAsym shell (seeg plausible): 98.8% of the contacts inside it, farthest outside 2.3 mm. This is a plausibility check, not an error estimate: the shell has no sulci, so the median distance of depth contacts to it (10.0 mm) says nothing about accuracy. SPM template spaces differ from MNI152NLin2009cAsym by a few millimeters.
